subject.title: [Bug]: Model-call OTEL spans drop explicit zero output usage

question: Should the fix land the broader context-pressure telemetry schema from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100115, or be narrowed to only preserving explicit zero-valued usage attributes?
rationale: The zero-output attribute preservation is a narrow bug fix, but adding bounded context utilization and terminal facts changes the diagnostics/OTEL schema surface and already has maintainer-review/product-decision labels.

options.title: Review linked telemetry PR
options.body: Resolve the conflicts and review the linked PR as the candidate for both zero preservation and agreed context-pressure telemetry.

options.title: Narrow to zero preservation
options.body: Ask for a smaller patch that only keeps explicit zero usage attributes and tracks context utilization separately.

options.title: Defer schema expansion
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product-design item if maintainers are not ready to standardize the new telemetry fields.

recommendation.title: Review linked telemetry PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts and review the linked PR as the candidate for both zero preservation and agreed context-pressure telemetry.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and own the open linked candidate fix.
